description: Lists automation runs, newest first, one page at a time, with each run’s status, how long it took and what it sent. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

status.description: Only runs in this state: queued, running, waiting, success, failure, cancelled, timeout, skipped or unknown.

name: list_runs
title: List automation runs
